open_points.subject: Randomly minted entity identifiers
open_points.text: A01 rule 2 says `trial_execution_id`, `binding_id`, `run_id`, `approval_id` and `grant_id` “are minted at random by the kernel; one that already exists is minted again,” but State 3 assigns no module ownership of A01 rule 2 or of the randomness and collision-retry mechanism.
open_points.question: Which module owns generating these random identifiers, checking uniqueness and retrying collisions, and how do `functions`, `bindings`, `runs` and `effects` obtain them?
options: `store` mints them atomically while inserting each record
Each record-owning module mints its own identifiers and asks `store` to reject collisions
A separate lower-level identifier or entropy module owns minting
open_points.default_guess: Have `store` mint and collision-check each identifier inside the record-creation transaction.
